cases.input: One immutable test revision executes against release digests A and B.
cases.expect: Two executions and evidence sets reference one definition revision and distinct subjects.

cases.input: Three attempts on the same digest produce pass fail pass.
cases.expect: All attempts remain; aggregate is classified flaky rather than overwritten passed.

cases.input: Execution aborts because the environment is unavailable.
cases.expect: Result is blocked or inconclusive, not product failed.

cases.input: Observations are valid but the expected comparator is incorrect.
cases.expect: Supersede the adjudication or definition; do not alter raw observations.

cases.input: Several executions cite the same defect with raised reproduced and verified-fixed roles.
cases.expect: Execution verdicts and defect state remain independently governed.

cases.input: A requirement changes after a test execution.
cases.expect: Historical execution remains pinned to the original requirement and test revisions.

cases.input: A public export redacts sensitive attachments.
cases.expect: Original sealed manifest remains intact and export records derivation and omissions.
